_doc: Nightly spend governor for the conductor family (setup/scripts/conductor_budget.py, STAGE 0 of automation/prompts/conductor.md). Created 2026-07-25 after a measured census found the conductor family = 93.3% of automation token burn ($149.57/day of $160.26). daily_cap_usd is compared against CORRECTED spend: conductor-outcomes.jsonl's self-reported cost_usd is multiplied by 2.2 because the conductor under-reports its own cost by that factor (measured $7.69/fire real vs $3.44 self-reported). Tune these numbers here -- no code change needed. Set enabled=false to bypass the governor entirely. | 2026-08-30: max_fires 4 -> 8. The COUNT cap was binding at 4 while only $3.67 of the $30 daily cap had been spent (~$1.22 per fire that actually launches, so money binds near 24). daily_cap_usd is unchanged and remains the real guard. Revert: set max_fires back to 4.
